demos.name: MCP Scanner Lab
demos.description: The four Tool & Agent Safety categories of the PingOne Privilege AI Gateway guardrails (tool poisoning, schema violation, tool abuse, inter-agent abuse), demonstrated on demo fixtures or your own pasted metadata, Agent Card and tool-call JSON. The lab detects; the Privilege gateway enforces (see the AI-DEMO2 Attack Lab).
demos.notes: Host-run: npm start (port 7650, loopback). Mock: built-in poisoned fixtures, no tenant, no network. Real: paste your own data; still in-process. Docker: HOST_PORT=7650 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). catalogId needs owner assignment.
